close.message: You still hold the SpeleoDB write lock. Release it so others can edit?
close.dirtyMessage: You have unpushed changes and still hold the SpeleoDB write lock. Push your changes and release the lock before closing?
close.savedLocallyNote: Your changes are saved locally - they just haven't been uploaded to SpeleoDB yet.

divergence.title: Resolve SpeleoDB conflict
divergence.description: Your local changes and the version on SpeleoDB have diverged. Choose how to resolve it.

keepLocal.label: Keep my local version
keepLocal.help: Upload your version to SpeleoDB to resolve the conflict.

takeRemote.label: Take the SpeleoDB version
takeRemote.help: Discard your local changes and replace them with the server's version.

confirm.title: Discard your local changes?
confirm.warning: This permanently destroys your unpushed local edits since the last sync. They are not saved anywhere else and this cannot be undone.
confirm.hint: To keep your work instead, go Back and choose "Save my version as an unmanaged file".

saveCopy.label: Save my version as an unmanaged file
saveCopy.help: Keep your edits in a separate local .stalx (no longer linked to SpeleoDB); the SpeleoDB project stays at the server's version.

toasts.editing: You now hold the lock - editing enabled.
toasts.lockedBy: Unable to lock the project right now - it's being edited by {{email}}. Please try again later.
toasts.takeRemoteFailed: Could not take the SpeleoDB version

done.title: Finish editing
done.description: Upload your changes to SpeleoDB and release the lock.
done.pushDescription: Upload your changes to SpeleoDB and keep the lock so you can carry on editing.

noPermission.title: No SpeleoDB access
noPermission.description: This project is linked to SpeleoDB, but your account doesn't have permission to view or edit it - it may have been shared with you as a file. You can convert it to a regular, unmanaged .stalx file to keep and edit locally.

banner.pushUnconfirmed: The upload could not be confirmed. Your changes are kept - click Done again to retry.
banner.concurrentSession: This project is locked by your account in another session. Editing from two sessions at once can lose edits.
banner.renderingDisabled: Web-map rendering is turned off for this project on SpeleoDB, so the online map won't refresh (it may show older geometry).
banner.enableRenderingConfirm: Rendering refreshes on your NEXT push, not right now (this does not re-render the current version). Enable it?
banner.noAnchor: This survey has no georeferenced zero datum, so SpeleoDB generated no new map geometry. Your data is still stored and shared; any existing online map may be stale.

heldLocks.title: You hold SpeleoDB locks
heldLocks.description_one: You still hold the write lock on this SpeleoDB project (perhaps from a session that did not exit cleanly). Others cannot edit it until it is released.
heldLocks.description_other: You still hold the write lock on {{count}} SpeleoDB projects (perhaps from a session that did not exit cleanly). Others cannot edit them until they are released.

recentBadge.lockedByYou: Linked to SpeleoDB - locked by you

browser.title: Open from SpeleoDB
browser.loginPrompt: You're not signed in to SpeleoDB. Sign in from Settings to browse your projects.
browser.noProjects: No projects visible to this account.
browser.concurrentSession: This project is already locked by your account in another session. Editing it from two sessions at once is unsupported and can lose edits.

projectSettings.title: SpeleoDB project
projectSettings.coordinatesHint: Latitude and longitude go together - fill in both or leave both blank.

rendering.label: Web-map rendering
rendering.enabledNote: Rendering is enabled - the online map refreshes on each push.

publish.title: Publish to SpeleoDB
publish.description: Create this project on SpeleoDB and upload its first revision.
publish.reloadFailed: Published to SpeleoDB, but the project could not be reopened. Reopen it from SpeleoDB.
